Builder equality checks actualfilelist vs this sealedcontract; it does not infer completeness from directory walks. Actual completeness remains pending until that late scope exists.

file_schema.encoding: raw or gzip chosen from known size/transport policy, not outcomes
file_schema.relative_path: canonical package-relative POSIX logical restored path, no absolute/../backslash/v112/cache/.pyc

opaque_io.GitHub_single_file_limit: Root late entry supplies the active limit; must exceed64MiB. Raw oversized item fails withpersistentfailure instead of silently altering scope.
opaque_io.builder_decompression_test: Every gzip stream independently decompressed into SHA+size before packaging. Original full bytes/header exact.
opaque_io.gzip_original_bytes: Entire original NPY/PT/PNG/CSV/etc, no parsing or numericdecode
opaque_io.physical_paths: raw at logical relativepath; gzip at transport/<logical>.gz or .gz.part0000 etc
opaque_io.split: Only if compressedstream exceeds Root supplied single_file_limit_bytes; parts fixed64MiB, orderedpartlist; splitting itself uses1MiB chunks and verifies concatenated compressedSHA before removing temporaryunsplitstream.

outputs: FAILURE.json preserves partialattempt iferror; noauto retry
restoration: stdlib-only verify all physical SHA/size first, then fresh output reconstruct each originallogicalpath by raw concatenation or ordered gzipstream. Original sourceabs pointers ignored even if files missing. Exact whole original SHA/size verifies original NPYheaderbytes without NumPy.
root_scope: Bound JSON {approved_actual_publication_package:true, entry_contract: trueentry minus root_scope}. Falseentry stops before sourcebody.
source_scope: No current/held payloads, no model/array decoding. Root late exact file bindings only; original metadata pointers are inert. Old public YCB/source dependencies must be explicitly supplied if copied, never automatically followed.
